Privacy Policy

Last Updated: June 2026

1. Introduction

course4me is committed to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your information when you use our website and services.

By using course4me, creating an account, booking a course, or making a payment through our platform, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We Collect

To provide our services effectively, course4me may collect certain personal, booking, and technical information when you browse courses, create an account, make bookings, or interact with our platform.

  • 2.1

    Personal Information

    We may collect personal details including your full name, email address, phone number, billing information, and account credentials when you register or use our services.

  • 2.2

    Course & Booking Information

    This includes selected courses, training locations, booking history, certification details, and other information required to process and manage your course bookings.

  • 2.3

    Payment Information

    When making payments through course4me, transaction references, payment status, and billing details may be collected. Full payment card information is processed securely by trusted payment providers and is not stored by course4me.

  • 2.4

    Technical Information

    We automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, device information, cookies, analytics data, and website usage activity to improve platform performance and security.

  • 2.5

    Communications & Support

    If you contact our support team, submit enquiries, or communicate with us through forms, emails, or live chat, we may collect information related to those interactions to provide assistance and improve customer service.

3. How We Use Your Information

course4me uses the information we collect to provide, improve, and maintain our services. Your information helps us deliver a secure and personalized experience when searching, booking, and managing courses.

  • 3.1

    Process Course Bookings

    To register you for selected courses, confirm bookings, and communicate with training providers.

  • 3.2

    Provide Customer Support

    To respond to enquiries, resolve issues, provide assistance, and improve customer satisfaction.

  • 3.3

    Send Booking Updates

    To send booking confirmations, reminders, schedule changes, payment receipts, and important course-related notifications.

  • 3.4

    Improve User Experience

    To analyse website usage, improve navigation, enhance search functionality, and optimize overall platform performance.

  • 3.5

    Prevent Fraud & Security Risks

    To detect suspicious activity, protect accounts, prevent fraudulent transactions, and maintain the security of our platform.

  • 3.6

    Meet Legal Requirements

    To comply with applicable laws, regulations, government requests, and legal obligations.

4. Secure Payments & Data Protection

course4me takes the security of your personal information seriously. All online payments are processed through trusted third-party payment providers using secure encrypted connections. We do not store full payment card details on our systems.

  • SSL encryption to protect data transmitted through our website.
  • Secure payment processing through trusted payment providers.
  • Access controls to restrict unauthorised access to personal information.
  • Fraud monitoring and security procedures to help detect suspicious activity.
  • Secure servers and hosting environments.
  • Regular reviews of our security practices and systems.

5. Sharing Information With Training Providers

To successfully process course bookings and deliver training services, course4me may share relevant information with the training provider selected by you. We only share information that is necessary for course administration, attendance, certification, and support purposes.

  • 5.1

    Booking Confirmation

    Training providers may receive your booking information to confirm course registration, reserve your place, and provide important course-related updates.

  • 5.2

    Certification & Qualification Processing

    Where applicable, training providers may use your details to issue certificates, qualifications, and official course completion records.

  • 5.3

    Training & Customer Support

    Providers may contact you regarding course schedules, venue details, training materials, assessments, and support related to your booking.

  • 5.4

    Limited & Necessary Sharing

    course4me only shares information that is reasonably required to deliver the booked course and related services. We do not sell your personal information to training providers or other third parties.

6. Your Rights

Depending on applicable data protection laws, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information.

1

Access Your Data

Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.

2

Correct Information

Update or correct inaccurate or incomplete information.

3

Request Deletion

Ask us to remove your personal data where legally permitted.

4

Withdraw Consent

Opt out of marketing communications at any time.

7. Changes To This Policy

courses4me may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, security practices, or operational processes.

Any updates will be published on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date. Where required by law, we may also notify users through email or platform notifications.

Continued use of course4me after any changes become effective constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team.
